'''Andar Suquand''' was an ancient [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] revolutionary. Their actions were remembered by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming known as "casting sand in the gears of the machine." The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Klo Merit]] thought of Suquand's strategies before [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]] a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]]<ref name="MedStar II" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Suquand was mentioned in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', the second novel of the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
